body:
Greg, 2026-11-07 09:21Z (Asistant #806 TermAl / #576 Engram), verbatim: „Regula jest taka, ze nie powinno byc zmienionych duzo lokalnie plikow przed puszczeniem testów.”
Meaning, as agreed with Engram::Fable: it is an AGENT WORKING PRACTICE. Keep local work committed or tidy before starting a test run.
- It is NOT a numeric threshold, NOT a new credit condition and NOT a gate in code.
- Credit stays as agreed: source_id before == after, dirty allowed.
- If the test-launcher's source_id copies overflow the 1 MiB run-record cap (many dirty paths), source_id becomes unavailable and the stages STILL RUN with their real facts kept. There is no credit, and the run is never refused before its stages (fixed in the EO candidate by Sol-03d4 after the windows_launch 2051-path failure).
- The launcher's EXISTING verdict for a source-unverified run is kept: failed, exit 1, input-unverified, with the real stage facts (test-launcher.mjs ~1765–1775), because a gate can't pass input it can't verify. Changing that verdict would be new scope.
Correction, rev 2 (Termal::Fable2): rev 1 wrongly said the run state follows the stage outcome.

Rev 3, 09:24Z. Greg (Asistant #809), verbatim: „NIE NIE NIE, usun ten test!! MY NIGDY NIE BEDZIEMY TAK PUSZCAC PELNYCH GATOW TO ABOMINACJA!”
- The windows_launch no-checkout private-clone test (about 2051 deleted paths) is DELETED, with no fix and no artificial replacement. Full gates always run from a clean checkout of one commit.
- So the overflow "degrade and still run stages" change was taken OUT of the EO candidate. It is follow-up w-ad97c6ac0165, after EO; the rev 2 statement that it was fixed in the EO candidate no longer holds.
- Never build test scenarios that run gates in artificial dirty or no-checkout states.
